contentSource.revision: Draft revised 3 November 2026; read 2026-11-04. Where the scratchpad .py drafts and the doc differed, the doc was used.
contentSource.rule: Each card is one screen's Text, copied unchanged. Screens from the go-today and home-care tab also carry their own 'If it gets worse' line as a second paragraph; the 'Clinician check:' notes inside two of those lines were removed because they are reviewer notes, not caregiver copy.

monthTable.status: draft - RHIYW to confirm how women and the antenatal card count months
monthTable.caregiverWording: Deck titles say 'about weeks ...' so a range is never shown as settled.

noStageIsSaved: Opening a month deck records nothing and never sets the woman's stage of pregnancy. The decks are read-only story.deck content. The 'I do not know my month' deck uses existing screens only and points her to the health worker and the dates on her card; the app has no due-date or dates tool yet.
sharedContent: A screen that appears in several decks uses the same phrase slug everywhere (one text, one translation). Any future topic menu must reuse these slugs, not copy the text.
placementRules: Sections and screen lists follow the doc's Monthly view tab.
The doc lists any-time screens once, under months 1-3. The any-time danger signs are repeated in every month deck (safety); other any-time screens are not repeated, to keep the decks bounded.
Learn-surface home-care screens from the go-today tab are placed under 'Common concerns and home care' by their week range; 'Small problems: care at home' opens that section wherever it appears.
'One tablet every day' is placed before 'How long to take it' in months 8 and 9, so the 'it' has its referent.
'Choose now who will take you' closes each Danger signs section.
'Getting ready for the birth' appears from month 7 only.

pictures.mechanism: Each frame has empty assetIds, so the trusted player shows its built-in 'Picture description' placeholder with the frame's imageDesc (the doc's Picture line). No image was generated.
pictures.knownIssue: The placeholder text is English in every locale, which ADR-059 does not allow. Decided by David, 2026-11-04: picture descriptions "should be cropped or covered with a text box to hold phrase bank phrases". Task T-085 will implement it (descriptions become phrase slugs; the player hides them or shows them in a manifest-driven text box). Until then this pack still shows English descriptions, flagged here.
